QF.id: VI Debt Instruments and Government Securities_23

question.text: Who can open a Primary SGL account?

answer.text: Only entities which fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed by RBI
Any investor with a demat account

explanation.text: The Logic: Only entities which fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed by RBI are permitted to open a Primary SGL account. The Trap: Eligibility is governed by RBI criteria, not by an assumed broad investor or SEBI registration category. Note: Access is restricted to RBI-eligible entities; the workbook does not enumerate specific holder examples for this provision.
